originalTitle: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
simplifiedContent: Here's what's happening in the stock market: Indian stocks have been losing value for five days in a row, partly because oil prices are high and foreign investors are selling their shares. Analysts are watching certain levels to see how the market will move next, and they're also looking at how individual stocks are performing. This all matters because it can help investors decide what to do with their money on Monday.

originalTitle: US Fed action, oil swings to test bullion as traders eye West Asia risks: Analysts
simplifiedContent: This week is important for gold and silver prices because the US Federal Reserve (the country's central bank) will decide whether to change interest rates. Traders are also watching oil prices, which can affect gold and silver, and are concerned about tensions between the US and Iran. These factors, along with some important economic reports, will likely influence the prices of gold and silver. This means that investors who own gold and silver should pay close attention to what happens this week. The combination of these events could lead to big changes in the prices of these precious metals.

originalTitle: GS, Nomura, Axis hired to run Carlyle’s India automotive platform IPO
simplifiedContent: Carlyle, a big investment company, is planning to sell some of its shares in an Indian car parts business called Highway Roop Precision Technologies through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). An IPO is when a company sells its shares to the public for the first time. Carlyle has hired some big banks, including GS, Nomura, and Axis, to help manage the sale, which could be worth around $500 million. This means that Carlyle is trying to sell its stake in the company, and the sale could value Highway Roop Precision Technologies at around $2 billion. This is important because it shows that Carlyle is looking to make money from its investment in the company.

originalTitle: Wall Street Week Ahead: Fed decision, big tech earnings and Middle East conflict in focus
simplifiedContent: This week, investors are waiting to hear from the Federal Reserve, which is expected to keep interest rates the same. Interest rates are currently between 3.50% and 3.75%, and this decision will be announced soon. This matters because interest rates can affect the overall economy and the stock market. The Federal Reserve's decision will be watched closely, along with other big events like earnings reports from major tech companies and ongoing conflicts in the Middle East. These events can all impact the stock market, so investors are paying close attention to what happens this week.

originalTitle: CBDT issues crypto asset reporting guidelines for exchanges under Income-tax Act 2025
simplifiedContent: The government has created rules for cryptocurrency exchanges to report information about their users. This is because of a new law called the Income-tax Act 2025, which aims to keep track of people's income from cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin. The rules are based on international standards that have been agreed upon by a group of 20 major countries, known as the G20. This means that cryptocurrency exchanges will have to share information about their users with the government, which will help the government to keep track of tax payments. This change is important because it will help the government to ensure that people are paying the correct amount of tax on their cryptocurrency investments.

originalTitle: Wall St Week Ahead-US stocks face tests from Fed decision, tech-led earnings deluge
simplifiedContent: This week, the US stock market will be closely watched as two important events happen. The Federal Reserve (or "Fed") will make a decision that could impact the market, and many big technology companies will release their earnings reports. These earnings reports will show how well these companies have been doing, which could affect their stock prices. The combination of the Fed's decision and the earnings reports will be a test for the US stock market, and investors will be paying close attention to see how it reacts. This could be an important week for investors as it may determine the direction of the market.
